caption: The video captures a dancer in a bright studio, its left wall lined with floor-to-ceiling mirrors and its right side holding a window and ballet barre, with potted bamboo and a small white unit against the wall. She wears a dark blue long-sleeved top, black flared trousers and light shoes, standing in a lunge with one foot pointed forward. Her reflection tracks her movements as a mirrored image rather than a second person. Within the clip her arms, held crossed near her neck with head bowed, gradually lift and unfold, elbows rising before the hands open into classical gestures. As the arms extend outward to the sides, her head tilts up and turns, and her torso rotates slightly. Meanwhile her weight rocks from the back leg onto the front, the pointed toe shifting from front to back. The camera framing and background remain fixed throughout, the motion continuing smoothly with the arms still reaching outward as the excerpt ends.
relations: As the dancer's arms lift and unfold from her neck, her head tilts up and her torso rotates slightly.
Her weight shifts from the back leg to the front, causing the pointed toe to move from front to back.
The reflection on the left wall mirrors tracks her arm and body movements synchronously as a mirrored image.
The camera framing, ballet barre, potted bamboo, and white unit remain fixed in the background throughout the motion.
